reason: Adds web-based reasoning-effort configuration and provider/model routing controls for local subagents using custom LLM providers in DeepSeek Harness.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的第三方模型提供推理强度设置，并支持为本地子 Agent 调用选择提供商、模型和推理级别。
summaries.en: Adds reasoning-effort settings for third-party models in DeepSeek Harness and lets local subagent calls select a provider, model, and reasoning level.

capabilities: Adds a web settings page for configuring per-model reasoning effort
Writes provider configuration through the official settings.mutate API
Routes local subagent calls to selected providers and models
Passes configured reasoning effort values to compatible APIs
